# List of warships gifted by India

The following is a list of warships gifted by India to other countries.
1. INS Kirpan, Indian Navy gifted and transferred for the first time an active duty warship to any country in 2023.
1. UMS Minye Theinkhathu previously INS Sindhuvir, a Kilo-class submarine, Indian Navy gifted INS Sindhuvir renamed UMS Minye Theinkhathu to Myanmar Navy in 2020.
1. India gifted a Fast Patrol Vessel, and a Landing Craft Assault ship to Maldives in 2023.
2. India gifted offshore patrol vessel to Maldives in 2019.
3. India gifted MCGS Huravee a Trinkat class patrol vessel to Maldives in 2006.
1. India gifted INS Amar, a seaward defence boat to Mauritius way back in 1974.
2. India gifted 9 Mandovi class patrol boat and replaced them with 5 Praga class patrol craft in 2000.
3. India gifted T61, a SDB Mk.3 patrol boat in 1993.
4. India gifted CGS Observer in 2001, a AMPL (P-2000)-class interceptor boat.
1. India gifted Fast Patrol Vessel to Seychelles in 2021.
2. India gifted PS Constant a Trinkat-class patrol vessel to Seychelles in 2014.
3. India gifted PS Topaz a Trinkat-class patrol vessel to Seychelles in 2005.
4. India gifted an active-duty Indian Coast Guard Fast Interceptor Craft (FIC) C-449 to Seychelles on 24 February 2025. The ship has been rechristened PB Boudeuse after commissioning by Seychelles Defence Forces.
1. India gifted 2 Fast Interceptor Boats to Mozambique in 2019.
2. India gifted 2 Fast Interceptor Boats to Mozambique in 2021.
3. India gifted 2 waterjet powered Fast Interceptor Boats to Mozambique in 2024.
1. India gifted ICGS Varaha, Vikram class offshore patrol vessel to Sri Lanka in 2015.
Note
These were gifted by India to friendly and neighboring countries, and were not exported or sold.
